headline: Ghana Rules Out International Eurobond Issuance Until 2030 in New Debt Plan
summary: Ghana has ruled out issuing new sovereign Eurobonds until 2030 under its updated debt management strategy, prioritizing domestic and alternative financing sources.
why: Ghana completed a comprehensive external debt restructuring under the G20 Common Framework; its international borrowing moratorium reshapes African sovereign debt issuance.

impacts.name: Ghana Sovereign Bonds
impacts.why: Excluding Eurobond issuance until 2030 limits foreign hard-currency bond supply and guides fiscal financing toward domestic instruments.
